items.headline: Cisco's mail gateway can be rooted by one crafted email; found in a TAC support case, exploitation confirmed

immediate_action.action: A remote, unauthenticated attacker gains root on the appliance by sending it one crafted email; there is no workaround and no mitigation short of upgrading. Cisco found this in a TAC support case, and CISA lists it as exploited. Upgrade every physical and virtual Secure Email Gateway appliance today and hunt mail_logs for the pattern Cisco names before assuming a device is clean; a clean result does not rule out the S/MIME injection.
immediate_action.title: Patch every Cisco Secure Email Gateway now: unauthenticated root RCE via a single email, already exploited

items.summary: Cisco disclosed CVE-2026-76461 (CVSS 9.8) on 2026-09-14: an unauthenticated attacker who sends a single crafted email containing SQL statements to a Cisco Secure Email Gateway can execute arbitrary OS commands as root. Cisco confirms active exploitation and says the flaw was found during the resolution of a TAC support case; there is no workaround. CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog the same day. Cisco simultaneously shipped a hardening release fixing five further internally-found vulnerabilities in the same product; Cisco's hardening advisory says two vulnerabilities from its internal review are known to be exploited, this one and the arbitrary file write CVE-2026-76519. On 2026-10-31 Cisco re-released the 15.5.5-014 fix in light of new information related to exploit code available online, so a 15.5 appliance patched earlier needs a check of its Retro Remediation Engine version. Public Metasploit modules now exist for the exploited injection (merged 2026-11-05, its author's medium-confidence match to CVE-2026-76461) and for a second S/MIME injection that its author believes is CVE-2026-76443, for which Cisco names no fixed 16.0 build.

items.headline: PHP2Shell: CISA lists both flaws as exploited after honeypot code execution; update the runtime, not the CMS

immediate_action.action: Two unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaws in PHP itself are on CISA's exploited list since 2026-10-26, honeypots recorded working code execution and Palo Alto reports attacks on internet-exposed PAN-OS management interfaces, fixed builds (8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35) have been out since 2026-10-21, and public proofs of concept circulate. Isolate anything that cannot be updated from public networks, and check web roots, logs, crashes and unexpected processes, since an update does not remove an attacker who is already in.
immediate_action.title: Update the PHP runtime on every internet-facing host today

items.summary: The PHP project released 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 on 2026-10-21 to fix CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 4.0 9.2), two flaws in the runtime that allow unauthenticated remote code execution as the web worker account, most directly on Apache mod_php, with no upstream release for PHP 8.1 and older and a third path, CVE-2026-115560, left unfixed (keep session.upload_progress.enabled=0). As of 2026-10-22 BACS knew of no attack in Switzerland but said federal PHP applications were affected and that it had no complete overview of the update status, and Swiss cantons, universities, Cyon, the Lodur platform and Publica took sites offline as a precaution.

items.headline: N-central: 4EverAble2Shell exploited on 21+ servers, Agent2Shell adds SYSTEM on agents; disable Legacy API
items.summary: An independent researcher published proof-of-concept code on 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09 for what Huntress counts as 33 critical flaws in N-able's N-central remote monitoring and management appliance, and N-able released 2026.4 Hotfix 2 (build 2026.4.1.26) on 2026-11-10 with seven CVE ids; on-premises customers must upgrade their servers, then Agents and Probes. On 2026-11-12 the researcher published a second chain, 4EverAble2Shell, that pairs an Apache Axis 1.x flaw (CVE-2026-90436) with a separate root escalation and works against Hotfix 2 when the Legacy API is turned on and reachable: Huntback reports at least 21 production servers, 19 of them on Hotfix 2, running a cryptominer, Previdian's honeypot recorded attempts at the chain, and Huntress's latest guidance is that a Hotfix 2 server with the Legacy API disabled is not exposed to it. The same disclosure includes Agent2Shell, whose chains give an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the server SYSTEM commands on managed Windows endpoints and which N-able confirms also needs the Legacy API; N-able has published indicators of compromise for customers that have not disabled it, has no fix for the new claims and plans a follow-up hotfix; the Legacy API is off by default and keeping it disabled is the stated protection.

items.headline: ScreenConnect SCKit: second wave hits on-prem; disable RMM+, update technician clients to 26.6.5+
items.summary: Huntress saw an operator use access to several cloud-hosted ScreenConnect panels on 2026-11-11 to run Run Command as SYSTEM on groups of managed endpoints, installing an attacker-controlled second ScreenConnect client and the SCKit toolkit on at least 288 hosts at 48 organisations within 90 minutes; Sophos independently saw the same client deployments. Huntress later said the activity seems related to the third-party RMM+ extension, whose versions 1.0.31 and 1.0.32 accepted a blank access key; ConnectWise's CNA record CVE-2026-127063 (CVSS 4.0 9.3) says the extension uses a static API secret by default, names no fix and gives disabling as the mitigation, while a Huntress spokesperson says the panel-access vector is still unclear and Blackpoint calls the extensions' role unresolved. A second wave on 2026-11-13 hit 205 hosts at 41 organisations (Huntress) and appears to target on-premises instances with mitigations pending (Blackpoint); Microsoft describes a rogue client built to deliver a payload to the technician who connects, which ConnectWise says ScreenConnect clients 26.6.5 and later block.

items.headline: Danfoss AK-SM 800A: six unpatched pre-auth RCE flaws, Strict mode does not remove them; France blames IRGC
items.summary: Coopérative U, Intermarché and E. Leclerc confirmed a cyberattack on their refrigeration systems overnight on 11 to 12 October 2026, a remotely forced defrost at hundreds of French stores, and on 2026-11-09 France's foreign ministry attributed that campaign, and only that campaign, to the Iranian unit Shahid Kaveh. More followed: more than 115 stores in at least six more countries and the first German shops on 2026-11-02, altered cold-room settings at three sites of the French blood service through a supplier, and, per SRF on 2026-11-05, a Köniz butcher and three Volg stores in Switzerland. CERT-FR reports numerous compromises of Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC controllers and of Copeland xweb and Dixell xweb, and NCSC Switzerland rates the activity actively exploited. On 2026-11-11 Midnight Blue reported six pre-authentication remote-code-execution flaws in all Danfoss AK-SM 800A firmware up to 5.3.2, with no CVE identifier or fixed version and no known exploitation (BSI); CCB says updating, new passwords and Strict mode are insufficient, so removing internet exposure comes first, and BACS's statement of 2026-11-10 that updates fix the known flaws predates the report and does not cover the six.

items.headline: Check Point gateways exploited (PHP2Shell, root escalation): Jumbo R81.20 t174, R82 t132, R82.10 t52, R82.20 t14
items.summary: Check Point Research reports that from 2026-10-30 an attacker exploited unpatched Check Point gateways through the Mobile Access portal with PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), escalated to root with CVE-2026-123039 (CVSS 7.8, a local flaw in the dynamic_server process that Check Point says was exploited against a couple of dozen customers), installed a persistent backdoor and in the first wave deleted files on a VMware ESXi host. The fix for both is in Jumbo Hotfix Accumulator R81.20 take 174, R82 take 132, R82.10 take 52 and R82.20 take 14 or later, with none listed for R81.10 or R81, and the standalone PHP hotfix is not stated to cover CVE-2026-123039; sk1000302 itself carries no statement on exploitation.

actions: Tell the helpdesk, HR and payroll teams of every body whose staff are insured with Publica (including the federal administration and the ETH domain) or with the Pensionskasse Stadt Zürich, which says data of its insured persons and pensioners was stolen, that AHV number, date of birth, address, salary and IBAN may now be known to criminals and must not count as proof of identity, and route requests that quote them, a request to change a payout account included, to a call-back on a known number; for staff insured with Pensionskasse Post, the Bernische Pensionskasse (which can neither confirm nor rule out that its insured persons' data left), the Ticino cantonal fund IPCT (which found data of about 1,800 of its insured persons on the attacked server and writes to all its insured because it cannot exclude more), the Pensionskasse der Stadt Zug (which reports an elevated but unconfirmed risk that its insured persons' data left), a fund administered or advised by Libera AG or the Bernische Lehrerversicherungskasse apply the same rule until those funds report the scope; also tell insured staff that cantonal police warn of investment-fraud calls from people who know their salary and pension details, which prove nothing about the caller.

If your organisation's pension administration, HR or payroll runs on PK Softech software, is being migrated to it or tested on it, or your staff are insured with Pensionskasse Post, ask the supplier or the fund in writing whether your data, test data included, was in the affected environment, project, test and migration copies included, and what it holds outside the productive system.
items.headline: PK Softech apparently kept Publica data it had promised in writing to delete; Tamedia says Akira holds about 100 GB
items.summary: PK Softech AG, the software supplier of Publica and other Swiss pension funds, says unknown attackers used malware to reach part of its IT and that data must be assumed to have left; the Federal Prosecutor's Office is investigating and has added the case to its criminal proceeding against Akira. Tamedia reports that Akira holds about 100 GB and demands ransom, while PK Softech and the federal bodies say no concrete ransom demand reached them; Publica and several other funds say their insured persons' personal data has presumably left. Cantonal police warn that criminals could use leaked personal and financial data for investment-fraud calls.

items.headline: Node-RED flaw in Siemens IoT2050 hit a VulnCheck canary; V4.3.4-1 fixes Industrial OS, Example Image has no fix
items.summary: Siemens ProductCERT advisory SSA-834709 of 2026-08-11 discloses CVE-2026-58115, rated 10.0 on both CVSS 3.1 and 4.0: SIMATIC IoT2050 devices with Node-RED installed do not enforce authentication on the Node-RED HTTP interface, so an unauthenticated attacker with network reach can create a flow and run code with maximum privileges. Siemens' advisory, revised on 2026-11-10, lists the Advanced, Basic, M.2 and SM variants in two configurations: all versions below V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS, fixed in V4.3.4-1, and all versions running Example Image versions, for which no fix is available; Siemens offers uninstalling or hardening Node-RED as interim mitigations. VulnCheck reports that on 2026-10-30 one of its canaries caught exploitation, a single request that deployed a flow downloading and running a Linux bot, with web-shell flows from the same address since; the target was a canary and the activity looks like opportunistic mass scanning.

items.headline: Certighost AD CS flaw: Kaspersky sees a ransomware group attempting the public exploit; patch every Enterprise CA
items.summary: Researchers published exploitation details and a public PoC (2026-07-24) for "Certighost" (CVE-2026-54121), an Active Directory Certificate Services flaw Microsoft patched on 2026-07-14: a low-privileged domain user can make an Enterprise CA issue a certificate carrying a Domain Controller's identity, authenticate as that DC via PKINIT, and DCSync the krbtgt hash. items.headline: Barracuda ESG: CISA lists both flaws as exploited, Barracuda reports attacks; update to 9.4.0.029 or later
items.summary: Barracuda's advisory of 2026-11-02 covers CVE-2026-116606, a pre-authentication authorization bypass in the Email Security Gateway (CVSS 9.3) that lets an unauthenticated remote attacker restore a crafted backup archive through the configuration-import function, and CVE-2026-111560, a command injection in the timezone field (8.6) that also affects the Load Balancer ADC, Message Archiver, WAF Control Center, Web Application Firewall and Web Security Gateway; chained, they give root. watchTowr Labs showed on 2026-11-05 that the chain needs no account, one unauthenticated request to the login handler reaching the restore function, and Barracuda changed its advisory the same day to say authentication is not required for CVE-2026-116606, only that the administrative interface must be reachable; watchTowr published a detection tool. Barracuda added on 2026-11-09 that it has identified exploitation activity affecting a small number of organizations, without naming the flaw, the Canadian Cyber Centre says open-source reporting indicates CVE-2026-116606 is exploited in the wild, and CISA added both flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10 and marks both for forensic triage. Barracuda names firmware 9.4.0.029 as the fixed build while the CVE record lists builds before 9.4.0.030 as affected.

items.headline: Balbooa Gridbox for Joomla: anonymous Super User flaws exploited since July; update to 2.20.5.0
items.summary: The mySites.guru research campaign against Joomla third-party extensions produced six further disclosures between 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-23, and one of them changes technique class: the Balbooa Gridbox page builder (CVE-2026-61425) trusts a client-supplied cookie value as proof of identity, so setting an administrator's username in that cookie authenticates the requester as that user with no password and no existing session. A Joomla Super User can edit templates, which is PHP execution, so this is full site compromise from a single anonymous request. Fixed in Gridbox 2.20.1; the researcher says the vulnerable code shipped for at least nine months. The same week added unauthenticated SQL injection and order-forgery flaws in EasyStore, an invoice IDOR in Events Booking, and a critical unauthenticated upload in Membership Pro. A follow-up audit of Gridbox produced eleven more CVEs, fixed in 2.20.2, four of them exploited in the wild, and Gridbox 2.20.3.1 (21 September) fixes a further unauthenticated SQL injection present in every earlier build. Gridbox 2.20.4.2 (27 October) fixes two more unauthenticated SQL injections, CVE-2026-102788 and CVE-2026-102789, with no exploitation reported, and Gridbox version 2.20.5.0 (4 November) fixes four more flaws, the worst an unauthenticated file deletion, also with no exploitation reported.

items.headline: C3RB3R ransomware encrypts Synology NAS; Synology confirms exploitation, 360 names the September 9.8 pair
items.summary: Synology said on 2026-10-29 that threat actors are exploiting a vulnerability patched in December 2024 to encrypt and extort devices on outdated DSM, naming no CVE and pointing to Synology-SA-24:20, while the Chinese vendor 360 identifies the ransomware as C3RB3R, a Cerber variant, and says it got in through CVE-2026-13684 and CVE-2026-13639, the two unauthenticated CVSS 9.8 flaws of Synology-SA-26:13 (fixed in DSM 7.4-90075, 7.3.2-86009-4, 7.2.2-72806-9 and 7.2.1-69057-12, with no mitigation). actions: In every Entra tenant you run or manage for others, list the app registrations that hold client secrets, starting with multitenant, delegated-admin (GDAP) and Partner Center apps, security-tool integration apps and Azure DevOps service connections, and search the service-principal and non-interactive sign-in logs for the invalid-secret or expired-secret errors AADSTS7000215 and AADSTS7000222 followed by a success for the same app; on any hit remove all client secrets, certificates and federated credentials on that app, including ones you did not add, disable its service principal if needed and rotate everything stored in any Key Vault it could read, because issued tokens stay valid until they expire.
items.headline: Entra app-credential abuse: agents hunt GitHub for secrets, an operator reaches MSP clients, government among them
items.summary: Microsoft reports that since August threat actors have used the agentic framework ARTEX to query public GitHub for OAuth application secrets and cloud keys, and that from 2026-10-28 valid application credentials were used for service-principal sign-ins across dozens of applications in several tenants, a vendor-owned multitenant application among them. Todyl's telemetry shows one operator since 2026-11-01 targeting about 45 application registrations at MSPs, more than 33 of which authenticated, and reaching 27 organisations, government clients among them; Microsoft says a similar campaign involving the same addresses was reported by Todyl, and Todyl's update of 2026-11-06 now assesses its operator as an automated agentic credential crawler, likely fed by secrets exposed in public repositories or web apps.

items.headline: Vaud: device-code phishing against Microsoft 365 is running in Romandie; several organisations already affected

items.headline: VMware vCenter's pre-auth Syslog RCE is exploited; patch it with the auth bypass and VMXNET3 escape, no workaround
items.summary: Broadcom's VMSA-2026-0006 (2026-07-29) fixes five flaws across VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation and Fusion, and NCSC-CH, NCSC-NL and BSI CERT-Bund all carried it across 2026-07-28 and 2026-07-29. CVE-2026-59309 (CVSS 9.8) is an authentication bypass in vCenter's Directory Service reachable with nothing but network access to vCenter, and CVE-2026-59310 (CVSS 9.8) is a directory traversal in vCenter's Syslog server that reaches arbitrary code execution. CVE-2026-47876 (CVSS 9.3) is an out-of-bounds write in the VMXNET3 virtual network adapter that lets a guest administrator execute code on the ESX host, affecting only VMs using that adapter. No workaround exists for any of the five, so patching is the only control. All were reported privately to Broadcom, one of them through Pwn2Own, and CVE-2026-59310 has since been exploited in the wild and was added to CISA's KEV catalog on 2026-08-18; CISA also listed the ESX logging flaw CVE-2026-41709 as exploited on 2026-10-28, the day CrowdStrike said the actor WARP PANDA used it as a zero-day.

actions: Patch CVE-2026-46300 on every Linux host that runs PHP or other internet-facing code, then on multi-tenant hosts, container nodes and CI runners: apply the distribution kernel update and reboot; until then, where IPsec is not in use, block and unload the `esp4`, `esp6` and `rxrpc` modules (this breaks IPsec), and drop the page cache so a file already modified in memory reloads from disk.

items.headline: CVE-2026-46300 (Fragnesia): CISA lists the Linux kernel root flaw as exploited, chained with PHP2Shell
items.summary: CVE-2026-46300 ("Fragnesia", CVSS 7.8) is a local privilege escalation in the Linux kernel's xfrm ESP-in-TCP path, one of three CVEs Red Hat groups as "Dirty Frag"; CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-28 and says it can be chained with the PHP2Shell flaws CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root, and Dream Research reports such a chain against 25 Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS firewall and management servers and a US government-affiliated network. Its public exploit overwrites /usr/bin/su in the page cache, and Red Hat confirms RHEL kernels are affected (CISA KEV, 2026-10-28 · Dream Research, 2026-10-29 · Red Hat RHSB-2026-003).

actions: Take the management interface of every PA-Series and VM-Series firewall and Panorama off the internet now by restricting it to a jump box or trusted internal addresses, because Palo Alto reports active exploitation against internet-exposed management interfaces, and install the hotfix for your maintenance release, which Palo Alto's table lists for every line from 10.2.7 to 12.2.4 (11.2.10-h17 adds the Brotli fix).

items.summary: The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates were so weak that anyone could recover them and forge trusted HTTPS certificates for any site, and eMudhra's incident report of 2026-11-10 adds eight RSA intermediates revoked on 2026-11-07 because it cannot show their keys were handled as its policy requires. items.headline: Linux TCP use-after-free: Sophos hotfix and Ubuntu generic kernels out; WatchGuard, Fortinet have no fixed build
items.summary: The Linux kernel CVE team published CVE-2026-98432 on 2026-10-15, a use-after-free in the IPv4 TCP connection setup path that dates to Linux 4.4 and is reached by a SYN packet carrying IP options; the CNA scores it CVSS 9.8. Anthropic reports that Claude wrote an exploit giving a remote, unauthenticated attacker root on servers with a multipath TCP (MPTCP) listener, which CloudLinux's kernel team could not reproduce; the Go team says the bug is not specific to MPTCP and Akamai that disabling MPTCP does not prevent exploitation, and no source reports attacks. Citrix rates its XenServer 8.4 and 9 bulletin Critical and names fixes for Workload Balancing and Conversion Manager, XCP-ng released a kernel fix, MikroTik's RouterOS 7.25.1 and 7.24.6 list the CVE, Red Hat, Debian, CIQ and Amazon Linux kernels are fixed, Ubuntu has fixed its generic kernels for 22.04 to 26.10 while 20.04 and older and some HWE, FIPS, NVIDIA and Azure variant kernels were still in progress on 2026-11-10, and Sophos has shipped a Firewall hotfix and SD-RED firmware, while WatchGuard (Fireware OS, AP, Dimension) and Fortinet list their products as unresolved or under investigation without a fixed build, Fortinet offering an IPS virtual patch.

items.headline: Insikt: GhostFrame implant re-disables ESXi execInstalledOnly every five seconds and steals guest credentials
items.summary: Recorded Future's Insikt Group describes GhostFrame, a command-and-control and post-exploitation framework for VMware ESXi hosts that operators must already hold root on: its vmhostd-core implant persists through ESXi boot scripts, disables the ESXi firewall and the execInstalledOnly control about every five seconds, and a web panel controls guest VMs and runs VMkatz against memory snapshots and virtual disks to recover Windows credentials. Insikt links it to TAG-218, whose activity overlaps Settra ransomware and whose servers targeted SonicWall, Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet VPN appliances in the US and Europe from late August to October 2026.

items.headline: ESET: Turla's Cereal runs the victim's own Exchange server as C2 and wraps transport agents to collect mail
items.summary: ESET found a previously undocumented .NET toolset, Cereal, on a Kazakh government organisation's Exchange server in November 2025 and on a Romanian government organisation's from December 2025, and attributes it to Turla with high confidence. The compromised Exchange server is the command channel, answering requests on web paths that imitate Outlook Web Access, Autodiscover and ActiveSync, and a module injected into the transport service wraps existing transport agents to collect mail, in Romania configured to select messages to or from NATO and EU addresses; ESET could not determine the initial access method.

items.headline: Keycloak 26.8.2 fixes a SAML signature bypass that logs an unauthenticated attacker in as any federated user
items.summary: Keycloak 26.8.2, released on 2026-11-05, fixes CVE-2026-117691 (CVSS 3.1 9.1, no privileges or user interaction): the SAML HTTP-Redirect binding processes percent-encoded parameter names such as %53AMLResponse while signature verification checks only literal names, so a crafted unsigned SAML message is processed instead of a signed one and the attacker logs in as any federated user. items.headline: Microsoft: Storm-0940 runs ARTEX at machine speed; Mandiant now sees agent frameworks in incident-response cases
items.summary: Microsoft reports that since at least September 2026 Storm-0940, a China-state aligned actor, has used ARTEX, an open-source multi-agent LLM penetration-testing framework, to automate scanning, password spraying and OAuth-application abuse against hundreds of organizations across many industries including government, reaching privileged cloud access in under three hours in several cases; Expel saw the same infrastructure create its own accounts through Okta self-service registration. Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant report on 2026-10-31 that since late August they have seen ARTEX, PentAGI and CAIRN operated in incident-response cases, with ARTEX adopted by extortion groups and suspected PRC-nexus clusters whose victims include US government organizations, and that the original ARTEX repository was taken down in October while forks keep it in circulation. CrowdStrike and Recorded Future document another actor using the framework, and Seoul police referred a criminal group's leader to prosecutors on 2026-10-23 for extorting 38 of more than 90 organizations, with the same framework according to BleepingComputer. Microsoft adds on 2026-11-06 another cluster, the Cambodia-based, financially motivated Storm-3358 targeting financial organisations, and Check Point reads ten exposed operator consoles that show near-autonomous, opportunistic ARTEX campaigns. CERT-EU says AI-driven activity against the EU institutions it protects highly likely involved ARTEX.

items.headline: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI and in the official images stole cloud and AI credentials; removing the package does not stop it
items.summary: On 2026-10-21 LiteLLM 1.107.0, the open-source LLM gateway, shipped with malicious Python startup files in all seven PyPI wheels (live 11:39 to 13:23 UTC) and in the official GHCR and Docker Hub images behind the v1.107.0, latest, main-latest and main-stable tags (11:46 to 14:20 UTC); they run a credential stealer at every Python start and start a background loader that could execute code fetched from an attacker-chosen host, though Socket saw its pointer empty at 13:01 UTC. The maintainers' root-cause post of 2026-10-23 says an administrative key committed to a public repository on 2026-05-27 and never revoked gave the attacker, from 2026-10-10, a GitHub organization owner's CLI token, with which it stole two maintainers' tokens and, on 2026-10-21, overrode branch protection to build the release from a look-alike repository; Socket independently found secret-stealing workflows running on 2026-10-10. Wiz saw stolen AWS instance-role credentials tested about 4.5 hours after exfiltration; PyPI and the registries removed the release the same day and the maintainers say to pin 1.106.2 or an explicit earlier version.

items.headline: SpecterOps: iSCSI Target Server without CHAP lets a host that knows the target and initiator names read shared disks
items.summary: SpecterOps (2026-11-04) shows that a Windows iSCSI Target Server configured as a common cluster guide describes, with the optional CHAP step skipped, accepts a login from any host that knows the target host, the target name and an authorised initiator name, and the post says the host and the names can be found. The attacker then reads the shared disk below file-system permissions; where it holds a Hyper-V domain controller's virtual disk, the directory database and local credential stores are exposed. CHAP, network segmentation and volume encryption are the levers.

items.headline: GhostAction: fake security workflows now harvest whole git histories; rotating Actions secrets is not enough
items.summary: StepSecurity and Socket report that on 2026-10-08 the GhostAction campaign used the GitHub credentials of two open-source maintainers to commit a workflow disguised as a security audit straight to the default branch of 345 to 346 repositories, including one of an Uber-owned organisation, and that the workflow now sends the credentials found in the working tree and in the entire git history, besides the named Actions secrets, to a hardcoded address over plain HTTP. GitGuardian's own data puts the wave of 8 to 12 October at more than 30,000 repositories reached through about 1,900 compromised GitHub accounts, and says GitHub has prevented the workflow from running since 9 October. Between 13 and 21 October the operator pushed at least 72,026 further commits, mostly from accounts whose tokens were already used on 8 October, including a stealer disguised as a font file that a hidden VS Code task runs on developer machines, outside GitHub's workflow hold, and a cron job that survives cleaning the repository.
